newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SHARES CAPPED AT 1614 PTS RESISTANCE - OMEGA.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SHARES CAPPED AT 1614 PTS RESISTANCE - OMEGA.

text.p: Greek equities are unlikely to break upside resistance around 1,614 points as the market succumbs to selling because of limited interest on the buy side, said Omega Securities in a technical analysis report.
At current trading volumes, the benchmark index will move sideways within the 1,570-1,615 range in the near-term, it said.
And on a medium-term horizon, the index will only clear 1,615 points if its 45-day moving average is penetrated upwards by the price oscillator.

"On the downside, the index will find support at 1,568 points at the intersection of its moving average and its short-term support trend," it said. "Apart from turnover considerations, a rise above 1,615 points is not likely based on short-term indicators." --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
